notes.title: New Roadmap - 3rd Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
Troopers!

Next week, the 16h of June, is the third anniversary of Starship Troopers: Terran Command. To celebrate this - and to show you how we remain dedicated to supporting and expanding upon the game - we are sharing the year 4 roadmap today.

Without further ado, check the infographic below! But don’t stop there, as we go into more detail about its content further down in this post.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36290235/6f88c3f2e1abd429b30349d1918a98ddda81013e.jpg"]
Campaign Update | Summer 2025
The first free update brings new content and improvements to the base game and both of the existing DLCs. New player units have been added to the Kwalasha campaign - and several are also available in the DLC campaigns. Many Kwalasha missions have also been updated to focus on these new units and to enhance the overall experience.

The Raising Hell DLC will also receive a small amount of new Mercenary unit types, along with significant improvements to its campaign missions. The Urban Onslaught campaign has additionally been updated with several changes to its missions, mostly focused on the new units.

In addition to all of the above, this update includes significant performance improvements, specifically targeting the slowdowns you may have experienced during long play sessions and on larger maps.

All this new content will be available in the Open Beta next month.


Territory Mode | Autumn 2025
If you’ve been following our Dev Diaries, you know we have a new game mode - Territory Mode - in development. It offers unprecedented freedom in unit selection and tactics. Played on new maps crafted specifically for Territory Mode, you’ll battle the Arachnids to capture Territory Points, adding a fresh strategic layer to the game.

The base game and each DLC will get exclusive Territory Mode maps and their own unique Battle Group. Please see our last Dev Diary for full details, but in short: a Battle Group comprises a tailored set of unit types, technologies and gameplay mechanics - several available only to that group.

Choose your Battle Group and challenge the Arachnids across countless generated mission variations!


First “Battle Group” DLC | End of 2025
At the end of the year, we’ll release a new type of DLC that is focused exclusively on Territory Mode. Fight the Bugs on several new Territory Mode maps set on a brand new planet, with its own unique environment and bringing several new Arachnid unit types. Unlike the currently available DLCs, no story campaign will be included in this DLC. Instead, you’ll gain exclusive access to a uniquely themed Battle Group featuring its own units, technologies and gameplay mechanics.


New “Story Campaign” DLC | Early 2026
Early next year another big “story campaign” DLC will drop. Similar in scope to the Raising Hell and Urban Onslaught DLCs, this will feature a brand new story campaign, set on a jungle planet and featuring new characters, new units and new Arachnids.

In addition to the campaign content, the DLC also expands Territory Mode with new maps and its own unique Battle Group - featuring the units available in the campaign, as well as new technologies and gameplay mechanics.




We hope you’re as excited as we are, Troopers - your war against the Bugs is only just getting started!

Service guarantees citizenship.

notes.title: Territory Mode Beta - Major Update
notes.notes:
Troopers, Assemble!

Today, as part of the RTS-Fest celebration, we have released a major update for the Territory Mode Open Beta. This includes balance changes, new features, new gameplay mechanics and new Territory Maps. 

Open Beta Update

The Open Beta has been live for three weeks, and we’ve received invaluable feedback—thank you to all participants!
A detailed roadmap is coming soon, but for now, expect monthly updates with more maps, technologies, battle groups, and gameplay improvements. Your feedback is essential as we refine gameplay, balance, and technical stability. Keep it coming!
For those who need a quick recap: Territory Mode is a new game mode specifically designed for replayability. You fight the Arachnids over Territory Points on maps specifically crafted for Territory Mode. These points reward the player with the necessary resources required to purchase units, replace casualties and invest in new technologies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36290235/95d9324fbca2bf6f2d20f9de411868520fe5fa25.png

Main menu update

To support and present the new Territory Mode and all of its content, the main menu has been updated with a new content overview menu. This screen provides easy access to all content - Campaigns, Territory Mode and Challenge Missions - from the base game and the current and future DLCs.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36290235/be0bec55293d2be0a11b1bf55e76e8a9c9f7ffd4.png
New Territory Maps

Today’s update adds three new Territory Maps, doubling the amount that was previously available. This new set includes the first two maps that are exclusive to DLC owners.

 Runway Rage: The Arachnids have overrun this air base, leaving many TAC Fighters stranded on the runway. This map is available for free as part of the base game.
 Hotbed: We’ve established your base on top of a volcano to show the Bugs that we are not afraid! This map requires the Raising Hell DLC.
 Party Crash: Evict the Bugs from the narrow streets, rooftops and metro stations of Mahanagar's nightlife district. This map requires the Urban Onslaught DLC.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36290235/b17a1ac9d4b67e579acc7cbd25024f0e257f488c.png

Join the Open Beta
You can access all this new content by joining the Open Beta through the following steps:

 Right click on “Starship Troopers: Terran Command” in your Steam Library
 Click on Properties
 Click on Betas
 Click on drop-down menu and select "Beta - Open Beta"
 Steam should now automatically update the game
 Launch the game to play the Open Beta version

An update is now available on the open beta branch, adding Scenario Editor and Steam Workshop support for the Raising Hell DLC content. It allows you to create custom scenarios using DLC content, as well as play them through the Steam Workshop.
The update also includes an update of the new challenge missions for the Raising Hell DLC and several balance changes and fixes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36290235/4a593f89ca3f5d6c353846769c6f7aec8adc5d28.png

If you encounter technical problems or if you have feedback on the changes, you can let us know through the in-game feedback form (opened by pressing F11 while in the game), or on our discord’s beta channel.
Thank you for your service!

Important disclaimer: It is recommended that you only publish Raising Hell DLC scenarios using this beta. Scenarios created and published using the beta branch may not work for players that are on the default branch. Therefore, work on existing or new scenarios that only use the base game content should be done using the default branch.

To participate in the beta program, go through the following steps:

 Right click on Starship Troopers: Terran Command in your Steam Library
 Click on Properties
 Click on Betas
 Click on drop-down menu and select "Beta - Open Beta"
 Then Steam should automatically update the game and download the beta

notes.title: The free update Chemical Reaction is out now
notes.notes:
Chemical Reaction Update

After a period in Open Beta, we are releasing the Chemical Reaction Update for everyone.

Containing three new scenarios, one new unit type and the target priority setting, this is the largest free update so far.

[previewyoutube=tQwoYBw5S7c;full][/previewyoutube]

Let's have a look at its content:

- Three new scenarios, two of which make use of the first incarnation of a new high-score system;
- One new unit type: Chemical Troopers; this unit is currently only available in the new scenarios, but there are plans to include it in future content as well. It's a squad of expert troopers using biochemical weapons, which they use to great effect for exterminating anything with more than two legs;
- The Target Priority setting (TPS); units can be set to prioritize firing at specific enemy types instead of aiming for the nearest target. For instance, if you want to automatically target Spitter Bugs with your Snipers, TPS allows you to avoid that level of micromanagement.

You can find the full changelog here.

The New Missions

Chemical Reaction
Arachnid test subjects have broken out in a chemical lab and are now running amok throughout the facility. You are being sent down with a small squad, including several units of the new Chemical Troopers. While the incident is unfortunate, the situation provides an excellent opportunity to field test their new weapons.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36290235/3ebabe80e407de1baa0c8d6756fc76c13210186c.png
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36290235/e37cf8ea5420c0c0cb58751726de9ba0d9c452ba.png

Expanding Gases (Survival mission)
The Mobile Infantry conducted a large field experiment with the new chemical weapons after successful lab trials. They will be used to clear an industrial complex and defend it against endless Arachnid attack waves. Killing bugs will grant "requisition points," which can be used to request new units, open gates to new areas, or increase your War Support. The experiment's success will be determined by how long you survive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36290235/1f6b31fe481bd754a6a1774cf18909458b25f06d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36290235/0370112f5496bb61638e6f497fc422a0dde823e0.png

Lethal Propellant
As the Chemical Troopers continue to provide their value on the battlefield, Terran Command has sent them down into a large canyon crawling with Bugs.
Lead them along the rocky trail to clear out all hives, but carefully decide when to push and when to hold: More and more Arachnid hordes are entering the canyon from the rear!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36290235/72316c2bb925000a3fa23961c204aa444dd29e59.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36290235/97bf68c797cf84a2dcfec81501e3d374c8d9d10d.png

Open Beta Branch

If you are on the Open Beta, you don't need to opt out in order to download the update. You have exactly the same version of the game as players who are not and are now downloading the new update.
In fact we would be extremely grateful if you could stay on the Open Beta branch, because we are going to be needing more testers for future content very soon.

Chemical Reaction Stream

Later this week we are going to showcase the new update and play all the three scenarios live on Twitch.

Join us on Friday November 18 at www.twitch.tv/slitherinetv at 10 pm GMT.

20% off discount

Last but not least, the game is at 20% off until November 21, so if you're still on the fence this would be the best time to get on Kwalasha and join in the war effort. Service guarantees citizenship!

Balance changes:
- Tanker armor reduced from 120 to 100
- Scorpion armor reduced from 90 to 70
- Scorpion range reduced from 35 to 30
- Scorpion Armor-Piercing (AP) reduced from 80 to 60
- Rocket Trooper range reduced from 45 to 35
- Rifle Squad Armor-Piercing (AP) reduced
- Marauder primary weapon AP reduced
- Marauder Mortar Barrage accuracy increased, damage and blast radius reduced
- Marauder Drop Charge damage doubled
- Spitter AP increased from 0 to 40
- "Suppression Resistant" units can only be slowed by 50% instead of 70%
Settings:
- Removed option to disable "runInBackground" as it is suspected to cause GFX issues.
- Removed screen refresh rate selection as it is not properly supported.
- Game will no longer cap framerate to 60fps when vsync is off, instead it will use the screen's current refresh rate as cap.
- Fixed resolution reset when changing refresh rate.
- Hotfix for setting refresh rates for some machines, still being investigated.
Known issues:
 - Scorpion spawning rate is not balanced, we are still investigating the best way to fix the spawning rules.

notes.title: UPDATE FROM FEDERAL NETWORK
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36290235/5ba801abe4e2ac9ca813ada33f7b61521ca17285.jpg

The pandemic has sent more bugs our way.

When we first announced Starship Troopers: Terran Command in December 2019, FedNet soon became overwhelmed by the response and interest from people all over the globe who added it to their wishlists.  

 Therefore, the Federal Council authorized allocating additional resources toward development to ensure the quality of the game will meet fans' expectations. 

Then the pandemic hit the team hard, compromising efficiency and disrupting plans for mobilizing a launch in 2020. 

As a result of these factors, the game has now been moved to the second quarter of next year, but don't despair as you will soon be able to do your part with a chance to enlist in the closed beta tests. Join the Mobile Infantry and save the world. Service guarantees citizenship. 

Would you like to know more? 

Wishlist now:
